```{r setup}
#| include: false
options(scipen=999)
library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
diagnosis <- if (!is.null(params$data_file)) readRDS(params$data_file) else params$data
```

This report summarizes the key metrics and results from the interactive batch effect diagnostic session.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" icon="false"}
## Key Diagnosis-Related Parameters

**batch:** `r diagnosis$info$batch`

**covariates:** `r paste0(diagnosis$info$cov_shiny, collapse = ",")`

**model:** `r diagnosis$info$type`

**smooth:** `r ifelse(is.null(diagnosis$info$smooth), "", paste0(diagnosis$info$smooth, collapse = ","))`

**random:** `r ifelse(is.null(diagnosis$info$random), "", paste0(diagnosis$info$random, collapse = ","))`
:::

# Batch Variable Summary

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Below is a table summarizing the distribution of the batch variable, along with an indication of whether a batch level has been removed. Batch levels containing fewer than 3 observations will be removed.

```{r batch summary}
if (!is.null(diagnosis$info$summary_df)) {
  dplyr::as_tibble(diagnosis$info$summary_df) %>% mutate(`percentage (%)` = sprintf("%.3f", .data[["percentage (%)"]])) %>% arrange(desc(.data[["remove"]])) %>% DT::datatable(options = list(columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all")))) %>% formatStyle('remove', target = 'row', backgroundColor = styleEqual(c("removed"), "lightyellow"))
} else {
  "No data available for Batch Summary."
}
```

# Biological fixed effects

These estimates describe only the dataset supplied to this diagnosis run. Points
show biological fixed-effect coefficients and lines show available 95% intervals;
the dashed line is zero. Estimates retain the original feature units. The plot and
the table below follow the selected term and contrast. Unavailable estimates and
intervals are marked explicitly.

```{r biological-coefficient-plot}
#| results: asis
cat("\n```{=html}\n", diagnosis$biological_effects_html, "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

```{r biological-coefficient-table}
if (nrow(diagnosis$biological_fixed_effects) > 0) {
  diagnosis$biological_coefficient_widget
} else {
  cat("No biological fixed-effect terms were fitted.")
}
```

Interactions are conditional effects; main effects involved in interactions apply
at the recorded reference or coding-zero levels of the other interacting variables.
`lm` intervals use Student t; `lmer` intervals are approximate normal Wald intervals
for population fixed effects. GAM parametric intervals use mgcv's Bayesian
covariance conditional on fitted smoothing parameters. GAM smooth terms are
identified in the table as requiring a separate fitted smooth-effect view; their
basis coefficients are not interpretable slopes and are not plotted here.

# Global Batch Effect Diagnostics

------------------------------------------------------------------------

This section provides a qualitative visualization (T-SNE plot) and a quantitative statistical test (MDMR), if not skipped, illustrating whether a global batch effect exists.

::: panel-tabset
## T-SNE Plot

```{r}
#| fig-align: "center"
#| fig-width: 10

if (!is.null(diagnosis$tsne_df)) {
  batch <- diagnosis$info$batch
  tsne_df <- dplyr::as_tibble(diagnosis$tsne_df) %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ if (is.list(.)) unlist(.) else .))
  
  ggplot(tsne_df, aes(x = as.numeric(.data[["cor_1"]]), y = as.numeric(.data[["cor_2"]]), color = as.factor(.data[[batch]]))) +
         geom_point() +
         labs(x = "Dim 1", y = "Dim 2", color = "Batch") +
         theme(
           axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
           axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
           axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
           axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
         )
} else {
  cat("No data available.")
}

```

## MDMR

```{r}
if (!is.null(diagnosis$mdmr.summary)) {
  mdmr <- as_tibble(diagnosis$mdmr.summary) %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ if (is.list(.)) unlist(.) else .)) %>% mutate(sig = ifelse(is.na(sig), "", sig))
  mdmr %>% DT::datatable(options = list(columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all")))) %>% formatStyle(columns = c("p.value"), color = styleEqual(unlist(diagnosis$red), "red")) %>% formatStyle('sig', target = 'row', backgroundColor = styleEqual(c("*", "**", "***"), "lightyellow"))
} else {
  cat("No data available for MDMR Results.")
}

```

```{r}
if (!is.null(diagnosis$mdmr.summary)) {
  if(nrow(mdmr) >= 2 && mdmr$sig[2] %in% c("*", "**", "***")){
    cat("There's a significant global batch effect based on the MDMR test.")
  }else{
    cat("There's no significant global batch effect based on the MDMR test.")
  }
}

```
:::

# Individual Batch Effect Diagnostics

------------------------------------------------------------------------

This section provides several statistical tests illustrating whether individual batch effects exist, as well as the percentage of total individual batch effects.

## Additive Batch Effect

::: panel-tabset
### ANOVA

```{r}
anova_test_df <- as_tibble(diagnosis$anova_test_df) %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ if (is.list(.)) unlist(.) else .)) %>% mutate(sig = ifelse(is.na(sig), "", sig))
n <- nrow(anova_test_df)
if (n != 0) {
  anova_test_df %>% dplyr::select(.data[["feature"]], .data[["p.value"]], .data[["sig"]]) %>% datatable(options = list(columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = "_all")))) %>% formatStyle(columns = c("p.value"),color = styleEqual(unlist(diagnosis$red), "red")) %>% formatStyle(
          'sig',
          target = 'row',
          backgroundColor = styleEqual(c("*", "**", "***"), "lightyellow"))
} else {
  cat("No data available.")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(diagnosis$anova_test_df)) {
  pct <- 100 * (n - sum(anova_test_df$sig == ""))/n
  cat(paste0("The percentage of significant features is: ", round(pct, 2), "."))
}
```

```{r}
          'sig',
          target = 'row',
          backgroundColor = styleEqual(c("*", "**", "***"), "lightyellow"))
} else {
  cat("No data available.")
}
```

```{r}

```
